faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Associate position at IIT Jammu is 04-10-2026. Ensure all details are accurate before submission.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech or Ph.D. degree in Mechanical, Materials, or Aerospace Engineering from a university recognized by the government.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate position is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate role involves a shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position at IIT Jammu is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Jammu located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Jammu is located in Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Jammu and Kashmir apply?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications from eligible candidates in Jammu and Kashmir. However, it is advisable to check the detailed eligibility criteria in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description.
